title: Robot holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='22' rx='14' ry='16' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='16' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#ff8fa3' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Balloon knot -->
  <polygon points='70,38 68,42 72,42' fill='#d90429'/>
  <!-- Balloon string -->
  <path d='M70 42 Q68 52 62 58 Q56 64 52 66' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Robot body -->
  <rect x='30' y='58' width='30' height='28' rx='5' fill='#4cc9f0'/>
  <!-- Body highlight -->
  <rect x='33' y='61' width='8' height='20' rx='3' fill='#7ae0ff' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Body panel -->
  <rect x='40' y='66' width='10' height='8' rx='2' fill='#3a86ff'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='70' r='2' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- Left leg -->
  <rect x='34' y='86' width='8' height='8' rx='3' fill='#3a86ff'/>
  <!-- Right leg -->
  <rect x='48' y='86' width='8' height='8' rx='3' fill='#3a86ff'/>
  <!-- Left arm (down) -->
  <rect x='22' y='62' width='8' height='18' rx='4' fill='#4cc9f0'/>
  <!-- Right arm (up holding balloon) -->
  <path d='M52 64 Q56 60 52 66' stroke='#4cc9f0' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Hand right -->
  <circle cx='52' cy='64' r='4' fill='#7ae0ff'/>
  <!-- Hand left -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='82' r='4' fill='#7ae0ff'/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <rect x='41' y='54' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#3a86ff'/>
  <!-- Head (screen) -->
  <rect x='30' y='30' width='30' height='25' rx='6' fill='#1b263b'/>
  <!-- Screen glow face -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='40' r='3.5' fill='#00f5d4'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='40' r='3.5' fill='#00f5d4'/>
  <!-- Eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='39' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='39' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M38 47 Q45 52 52 47' stroke='#00f5d4' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Antenna -->
  <rect x='43' y='24' width='4' height='6' rx='1' fill='#3a86ff'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='22' r='3' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- Screen frame highlight -->
  <rect x='30' y='30' width='30' height='25' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#7ae0ff' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
